page.content:
Encyclopedia project on Terminus that becomes a power.

How First Foundation connects

  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon founds the First Foundation on Terminus.
  • Location: Terminus — The First Foundation is planted on Terminus.
  • Character: Salvor Hardin — Hardin leads Terminus as mayor through early crises.
  • Character: Hober Mallow — Mallow leads the Foundation as a trader-mayor.
  • Item: Encyclopedia Galactica — The Foundation begins under cover of the Encyclopedia Galactica.
  • Character: The Mule — The Mule conquers First Foundation worlds.
  • Character: Gaal Dornick — Gaal is drawn into Seldon's Foundation project.
  • Character: Bayta Darell — Bayta is a daughter of the First Foundation.

What is First Foundation?

The First Foundation begins as Seldon's band of encyclopedists on Terminus and becomes a trading, then political, force steering the Seldon Plan in the open.

Key threads lead to Hari Seldon, Terminus, Salvor Hardin, Hober Mallow, Encyclopedia Galactica and The Mule.
